scope_statement: Cross-vendor product-manual plot detection and physical trace identity.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Short, pale, dotted, or black-bordered plots fail detection; antialias shades create a false trace or hide a physical trace.
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The detector required five medium-gray rows and the tracker treated raster shades as independent identities without a geometric alias check.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: A product plot is visible but the interface reports zero detected traces and only asks for axis review, so the user cannot tell whether recognition succeeded.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: user screenshot of the public Image to S-Parameter page
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: Trace recovery was gated behind complete OCR axis calibration, and the rendered interface had no pre-calibration candidate state.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Positive insertion-loss plots and traces from images with different start, stop, and resolution cannot be reliably mapped and exported together.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: cross-vendor Samtec, JAE, and Rosenberger product-plot workflow
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The UI assumed negative S-parameter dB axes only, and validation stopped at trace counting instead of exercising mapping, common-grid interpolation, Touchstone generation, and reread.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: A near-0 dB transmission trace can fail export even when unused ports are intended to be ideally matched.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: JAE RF plus Rosenberger end-to-end generation
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The previous -80 dB fallback was tiny but nonzero, so its combination with a unity transmission could exceed the sampled passivity limit after rounding.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Both 0/5/0.1 and 0GHz/5GHz/0.1GHz are rejected for a linear plot whose X axis visibly starts at DC.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: user screenshot of Samtec p9 in the public Image to S-Parameter page
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The image form reused a generic strictly-positive parser and treated unitless entries as Hz even though Touchstone and the linear digitizer support DC.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Some Wilder VNA traces are detected only from the middle of the plot, with the first half missing.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: user rerun of Wilder 910-0077-000 Rev E Figures 33 and 36
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: A few steep notch transitions split one physical hue into continuity fragments; the conservative hue fallback then retained only the longest fragment even though a unique same-hue path spanned the plot.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Wilder Figure 36 Trace 4 appears full-width but switches between two physical blue-family curves.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: user visual review of the public Image to S-Parameter overlay
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: A hue-wide weighted median erased trace identity: numerous cross-path jumps incorrectly satisfied the old fallback condition.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: After the first Trace 4 repair, the real Wilder Figure 36 overlay still contains isolated columns that borrow the other blue trace; same-colour in-plot annotation can also replace part of a physical path.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: user second visual review of the public Image to S-Parameter overlay
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The joint tracker forced both identities to consume the only remaining blue observation for short missing-sample runs, while the single-hue fallback admitted short same-colour annotation runs. The previous p95-only gate hid these sparse but severe errors because they occupied less than five percent of the trace.
